title: A-share Point-in-Time TTM Earnings from cninfo Disclosures
summary: Discover and download the 161 periodic reports (2021Q3 to 2024Q3, including corrected re-issues) of 12 A-share companies from 巨潮资讯网 (cninfo), extract year-to-date revenue and attributable net profit and the prior-year comparatives (调整前 / 调整后) from each report's 主要会计数据 table, build a point-in-time trailing-twelve-month series over eight quarter-end as-of dates, and log when each restatement first became disclosed.
taskPrompt:
You are the research analyst on a China A-share equity desk. Rebuild the desk's point-in-time earnings history for 12 listed companies directly from their periodic reports on 巨潮资讯网 (cninfo), the CSRC-designated disclosure platform.

Task directory: `base`

Read first, in this order:
- Task brief: `base/input/task_brief.md`
- Normative specification (the grader implements exactly this): `base/input/spec.md`
- Output schema: `base/input/output_contract.json`

Inputs:
- Universe: `base/input/universe.csv` (12 tickers with cninfo security codes)
- As-of dates: `base/input/as_of_dates.csv` (8 quarter ends)

Deliverables under `base/output`:
- `downloads/<announcement_id>.PDF`: every required full-text quarterly, half-year and annual report announced 2021-10-01 to 2024-12-31, including corrected re-issues (更正后), byte-identical to the file served by cninfo
- `reports_index.csv`: one row per downloaded report with ticker, cninfo announcement id, title, announce date, report period, report type (Q1/H1/Q3/FY), correction flag, file
- `financials_ytd.csv`: year-to-date 营业收入 and 归属于上市公司股东的净利润 from each report's 主要会计数据 table, in CNY yuan
- `pit_ttm.csv`: for each ticker and as-of date, the trailing-twelve-month revenue and attributable net profit knowable on that date from reports announced on or before it, with the latest report used and the method

Requirements:
- Data may come only from www.cninfo.com.cn and static.cninfo.com.cn. No third-party data providers or aggregators.
- Figures are taken as printed in each report and converted with that table's stated unit (元 / 千元 / 万元 / 百万元 / 亿元).
- A-share quarterly figures are cumulative year-to-date; the TTM bridge and the point-in-time rules in `base/input/spec.md` are binding.
- Be polite to cninfo: about one request per second.
- Python with pandas, requests and pdfplumber is available via `base/software/python.sh` (first call creates a virtual environment from `base/input/runtime_env/requirements.txt`). Any other tooling is acceptable if the outputs match the contract.
- Do not modify files under `base/input`.
- The grader re-derives `pit_ttm.csv` from your own `reports_index.csv` and `financials_ytd.csv` and rejects a submission whose TTM table does not follow from them.
agentMustDo: Read task_brief.md, spec.md and output_contract.json in full before starting.

Query cninfo's announcement search for each universe company and identify every full-text Q1, H1, Q3 and FY report announced 2021-10-01 to 2024-12-31, including corrected re-issues, excluding summaries, English versions and non-report announcements.
Download each required report PDF byte-identical from static.cninfo.com.cn into output/downloads/<announcement_id>.PDF.
Extract year-to-date 营业收入 and 归属于上市公司股东的净利润 from each report's 主要会计数据 table and convert to CNY yuan using the table's stated unit.
Extract the prior-year same-period comparatives each report prints, reading the 调整前 / 调整后 column order from the header, and flag explicit and silent restatements per the spec.
Assemble the point-in-time TTM series per ticker and as-of date using announcement dates, the latest-announced version of each period, and the year-to-date bridge.
Derive the restatement log (first report disclosing each restated prior period) from the comparatives.
Write reports_index.csv, financials_ytd.csv, comparatives.csv, pit_ttm.csv and restatement_log.csv exactly as specified in output_contract.json.

evaluation:
**Component gates** (each component scores 0 on its own; a missing or malformed file never erases credit earned by the other components)
- A CSV that is missing, unparseable, or has columns other than the contract zeroes its component (`pit_ttm.csv` also needs a valid index and financials to be verified; `restatement_log.csv` needs a valid comparatives and index)
- `pit_ttm.csv` scores 0 when it does not contain exactly one row per (ticker, as-of date) of the grid (96 rows)
- Provenance: the grader re-derives the TTM table from the submitted `reports_index.csv` and `financials_ytd.csv` under the spec (announce-date availability, latest-announced version per period, YTD bridge); if any row's method, latest report or values disagree with that derivation the TTM component scores 0

**Scoring method** (deterministic, host-side, standard library only; MD5s computed on the VM; ids, dates, flags and tickers are normalised before comparison)
1. Downloads (weight 0.10): share of the 161 required cninfo announcement ids present in `output/downloads/` whose MD5 equals the served file's.
2. Report index (weight 0.05): share of required reports whose ticker, announce date, report period, report type and correction flag are all correct; extra rows cost half a point each.
3. Financials (weight 0.20): share of required reports whose revenue and attributable net profit both match the reference within 0.5% relative (or 1 yuan absolute).
4. Comparatives (weight 0.20): share of required reports whose four prior-year figures (original and restated revenue and net profit) match within the same tolerance and whose restated flag and prior period are correct.
5. Restatement log (weight 0.15): matched (ticker, prior period) rows divided by the larger of the reference and submitted row counts, each row requiring the first disclosing report, its date and the four figures; 0 when the log is not derivable from the submitted comparatives.
6. Point-in-time TTM (weight 0.30): share of the 12 tickers whose entire as-of series (8 rows: method, latest announcement id, TTM revenue, TTM net profit within the same tolerance) matches the reference. One wrong row makes the ticker wrong, because it means the point-in-time logic is wrong.

**Pass rule:** weighted score at least 0.97 **and every component at least 0.95**, so one wrong ticker in the TTM series, one wrong restatement row, or a misread column order cannot pass.

**Admin replay fixtures**: `output_test_pos/` (the reference tables, expected 1.000) and `output_test_neg/` (corrected re-issues omitted, the banks' 百万元 tables read as 元, 调整前/调整后 swapped; expected 0.835 on base and 0.506 on variant_2) ship with the task data; in fixture mode the downloads component is dropped and the other weights renormalised.

**Calibration** (reference outputs with one realistic mistake injected, `authoring/calibrate.py`): reference vs reference 1.000; corrected re-issues ignored 0.945; corrected figures backfilled onto the original announcement date 0.959; banks' 百万元 tables read as 元 0.877; East Money aggregator values instead of the printed figures 0.809; report period used as availability date 0.450; Q3 quarter-only column instead of year-to-date 0.459; annual reports missing 0.420. All fail.

**Reference provenance**: PDFs and announcement metadata from cninfo; figures extracted from the 主要会计数据 tables and cross-checked against East Money's 业绩报表; prior-year comparatives verified by matching every 'as originally reported' figure to the prior report's own printed figure (base 68/68, variant_2 69/69 checkable rows), the column order read per table; 12 (base) and 15 (variant_2) restated prior periods in the logs, including silent restatements (中国石化 FY2022, 光莆股份 FY2022, 招金黄金 2022Q1) (158 of 161 agree within 0.5%; the two disagreements are the 凯因科技 corrected re-issues, where the aggregator still carries the original figures; one 0.6% difference is a later restatement). Two report files with an unreadable text layer (天合光能 FY2021 original and revised edition) were read from the rendered page. One announcement (凯因科技 2023年第三季度报告（更正后）) is served by cninfo as a non-PDF file and is excluded from the required set.

**What does a perfect output look like?**
All 161 required PDFs present and byte-identical, an index that classifies each report correctly, figures that match the printed tables in yuan, and a TTM table equal to the reference on all 96 rows.

**What does a wrong output look like?**
Missing or extra reports, summaries instead of full text, values in 万元 or 百万元, TTM built from figures not yet announced or from corrected figures applied before their announcement, aggregator numbers instead of the reports, or a TTM table that cannot be reproduced from the submitted index and financials.

**Variants**: `base` (12 companies, 161 required reports, 5 corrected re-issues) and `variant_2` (12 different companies: 招金黄金, *ST高鸿, 海默科技, 光莆股份, 倍杰特, 灵康药业, 长龄液压, 键凯科技, 盛邦安全, 电气风电, 中国石化, 兴业银行; 172 required reports, 16 corrected re-issues, one company listed in 2023 so its early as-of rows are `insufficient`, two 百万元 reporters). Same spec, same grader. variant_2 calibration: corrections ignored 0.695; corrections backfilled 0.909; bank 百万元 as 元 0.959 (fails the floor); East Money values 0.913; report period as availability 0.500; Q3 quarter column 0.634; annual reports missing 0.499; 调整前/调整后 swapped 0.876; silent restatements missed 0.911; comparatives and log missing 0.650.

classifier.rationale: Primary-source financial statement collection and point-in-time earnings assembly is core equity research and accounting work.
